object.reason: The SOC dependency returns the corrected displacement p+w, but this algorithm treats the return as the correction w and tests x+p+w. That double-counts p; it should test the point formed by adding the returned displacement to x.
The title promises an exact penalty, but ρ is arbitrary: for min −x subject to x=0, ψρ(x)=−x+ρ|x| is below ψρ(0) for x>0 when 0<ρ<1, so it is not exact as stated.

Step 2 passes only h_E to SOC, whose interface requires all equality constraints. When E omits dependent equality rows, this call falls outside the supplied interface; QP basis reduction does not authorize that omission.
Step 2.1 incorrectly identifies the Armijo reference with the model at tp. For f(z)=2z, g(z)=z, x=1, B=1, p=−2, ρ=1, t=3/4, σ=1/2, the Armijo reference is 9/8, while the model value at tp is −1.
